title: Power Apps: speech as an input source for form fill assistance in model-driven apps
summary: The speech plan, default, licensing requirements and app-level controls are supported by the roadmap and Microsoft Learn. The environment-control path reaches the correct setting but should include the final environment selection and Edit setting step.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans speech input for form fill assistance in Power Apps model-driven apps.
claims.quote: We’re expanding form fill assistance in Power Apps to use speech as a source, providing users a more natural way to fill forms.

claims.claim: Users select a microphone icon to provide speech input.
claims.quote: Users select the microphone icon, record their content, and the transcript is used as a source for the form entry.

claims.claim: Users record their spoken content.
claims.quote: Users select the microphone icon, record their content, and the transcript is used as a source for the form entry.

claims.claim: The transcript supplies a source for form entry.
claims.quote: the transcript is used as a source for the form entry.

claims.claim: Form fill assistance suggests AI-generated field values.

claims.claim: Files are a currently documented source for form fill assistance.
claims.quote: Based on the file contents the user provides through the Files capability.

claims.claim: Pasted text is a currently documented source for form fill assistance.
claims.quote: Based on the copied text the user provides through the Smart paste capability.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented storage of the speech-source transcript.
claims.quote: Searched: "form fill" "transcript" retention microphone permissions; Power Apps form fill assistance speech input microphone transcript storage retention processing permissions speech switch. Opened form-filling-assistance and FAQ about form fill assistance; no speech-transcript storage passage.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented retention of the speech-source transcript.
claims.quote: Searched: "form fill" "transcript" retention microphone permissions. Opened Use AI form fill assistance feature in model-driven apps and FAQ about form fill assistance; neither describes retention of speech-source transcripts.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented this feature's speech-processing architecture.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps form fill assistance speech input microphone transcript storage retention processing permissions speech switch; "form fill" "speech". Opened form-filling-assistance and its responsible AI FAQ; neither identifies speech-processing components or regions.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented microphone permission requirements for this speech feature.
claims.quote: Searched: "form fill" "transcript" retention microphone permissions. Read form-filling-assistance and its FAQ. Results about the canvas Microphone control do not establish this model-driven speech feature's requirements.

claims.claim: Fields with column security are not supported for current form fill suggestions.
claims.quote: Fields that have column security aren't currently supported.

claims.claim: Usage may be subject to service limits.
claims.quote: Usage might be subject to service limits or throttling. Microsoft reserves the right to update the limits.

claims.claim: Microsoft has published no extra speech-specific meter or charge.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps form fill assistance speech licensing meter credits pricing. Opened form-filling-assistance and Pay-as-you-go meters, searching the latter for speech and form fill; no speech-specific charge or meter was documented.

claims.claim: The current form fill experience requires form fill assistance to be enabled.
claims.quote: At least one of the AI form fill assistance environment feature settings enabled.

claims.claim: The Allow form fill assistance column property must be enabled for current form fill suggestions.
claims.quote: The Allow form fill assistance column property enabled for the column where form fill assistance occurs.

claims.claim: Current in-app form fill assistance supports text, numeric, choice and date fields.
claims.quote: The currently supported field types inside apps are text, numeric, choice, and date.

claims.claim: Learn marks the underlying Power Apps form fill feature as production ready preview.
claims.quote: This feature is in production ready preview in Power Apps.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance guidance; rendered controls table
claims.claim: The environment control is at Power Platform admin center > Copilot > Settings > Power Apps > Data entry.
claims.quote: The primary admin control for form fill assistance is moving to the Power Platform admin center under Copilot > Settings > Power Apps > Data entry.
claims.fix: Complete controls[0].ui.path and the matching rendered route as 'Copilot > Settings > Power Apps > Data entry > environment > Edit setting'. The final steps are documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/copilot/copilot-hub#settings.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls; rendered controls table
claims.claim: No API for the new environment Data entry control is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Platform Data entry Copilot settings form fill assistance API PowerShell pac admin environment settings; "Data entry" "setting" "entity" Copilot. Read form-filling-assistance, settings-features and Copilot hub; no matching operation.

claims.claim: The move to the Copilot Data entry setting is gradually rolling out.
claims.quote: This change is gradually rolling out.

claims.claim: Selecting a Copilot setting opens a panel in which the administrator selects an environment and Edit setting.
claims.quote: When you select a setting, a panel opens where you can select your environment or group, select Edit setting, and configure the control.

claims.claim: The maker path is Solutions > solution > app > Edit > Settings > Features > Form fill assist toolbar.
claims.quote: When you select Settings from the command bar, select Features to enable or disable model-driven app features for the app. ... Form fill assist toolbar.

claims.claim: saveSettingValue with FormFileUploadEnabled and overrideScope 2 updates the current app's form fill assist toolbar setting.
claims.quote: Xrm.Utility.getGlobalContext().saveSettingValue(settingName, value, saveSettingOptions).then(successCallback, errorCallback); ... Use 2 to add or update a setting app value.

claims.claim: The app should be saved and published after changing its designer settings.
claims.quote: You must select Publish to activate an app settings change. ... Save and Publish the app.

claims.claim: Smart paste is the separate FormPredictSmartPasteEnabled app setting.
claims.quote: Smart paste (FormPredictSmartPasteEnabled) and form fill assist toolbar (FormFileUploadEnabled) app settings

claims.claim: The designer reference names a Form fill assist toolbar control, which controls toolbar visibility.
claims.quote: Form fill assist toolbar. When enabled, the form fill assist toolbar is visible at the top of a form, providing easy access to Copilot form fill assistance capabilities like smart paste and files.

claims.where: controls[2].ui and controls[2].api; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: A separate speech-specific switch is not documented on either the UI or automation surface.
claims.quote: Searched: "form fill" "speech" "switch"; Power Apps form fill assistance speech input microphone transcript storage retention processing permissions speech switch. Opened form-filling-assistance, app-properties, client API setting reference, Copilot hub and settings-features; no speech switch.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not specifically described how existing form fill controls govern the planned speech source.
claims.quote: Searched: "form fill" "speech" "switch"; "form fill" "speech". Read form-filling-assistance, app-properties, settings-features and Copilot hub. These document general form fill controls but do not describe the planned speech source or speech-specific enforcement.

claims.claim: The feature settings reference lists legacy environment form fill settings and says those controls are being removed from that page.
claims.quote: The following settings are removed from the Environment > Settings > Features page. Access them through Manage model-driven app settings in the app designer or Solution Explorer App Settings.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not specifically confirmed the column-level form fill control's behaviour for speech input.
claims.quote: Searched: "form fill" "speech"; "form fill" "speech" "switch". Read form-filling-assistance and its FAQ: the column prerequisite is documented for current suggestions, but neither page describes the speech source or how that prerequisite affects speech input.
